final_message:
Configured DNS for all requested names and the `company.com` and `university.edu` mail exchanger records. All 40 PCs use the resolver; existing addresses, routes, and connections were preserved.

The artificial root runs on pc1, the TLD servers on pc2–pc5, the domain servers on pc6, pc8–pc10, pc12–pc15, pc21, pc32 and pc33, and the resolver on pc34. No images were changed; the configuration assumes the existing `kathara/base` image provides BIND.

Startup scripts passed shell syntax checks, and the client and server files were checked statically. BIND validation tools were unavailable, so live DNS resolution remains untested.
